A '''band''' consisting of seven [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|males]] was popular on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="Slugthrowers 2" /> During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|Blockade of Kashyyyk]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial technician|technician]] watched a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] performance of the band playing the song "[[Light the Sky on Fire]]." The holovid played inside a [[Music/Legends|music]] box in the [[Chewbacca's home|home]] of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family]] that the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and several other Imperials were searching for signs of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity. The band consisted of a [[Unidentified Human singer (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|lead singer]], three members playing plucked string instruments, a [[Unidentified Human drummer (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|drummer]], a [[Unidentified Human keyboardist (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|keyboardist]] and a man playing a wind instrument.<ref name="SWHS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There's a profound moment in the oft-lamented ''Star Wars'' Holiday Special, when Jefferson Starship frontman Marty Balin looks skyward as he ponders lyrically, 'Yes, I would really like to know. What are they watching us for?'|Alex Newborn|<ref name="bad">{{InsiderCite|106|I Have a Bad Feeling About This!}}</ref>}}
The band appears in [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', playing "[[Light the Sky on Fire]]." [[In-universe]], they have not been named to date, but they were played by the members of the real-life band [[Jefferson Starship]]: lead singer [[Marty Balin]], drummer [[John Barbata]], lead guitarist [[Craig Chaquico]], keyboardist [[David Freiberg]], rhythm guitarist [[Paul Kantner]], bass clarinetist [[Steven Schuster]], and bassist [[Pete Sears]].

In [[Edward M. Erdelac]]'s [[Star Wars Blog]] article [[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|''Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away, Part 2'']], "Light the Sky on Fire" is said to be popular on Kashyyyk during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The article also mentions another song popular on Kashyyyk, called "[[Hyperdrive (song)|Hyperdrive]]"&mdash;the title of another Jefferson Starship song which was released as the B-side for some releases of the "Light the Sky on Fire" single.
